name: ses-inbound-parser
description: Parse SES inbound .eml from S3 and insert into Supabase

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp index.mjs package.json dist/ && cd dist && npm install --omit=dev && zip -r ../ses-inbound-parser.zip .
scripts.deploy: aws lambda update-function-code --function-name ses-inbound-parser --zip-file fileb://ses-inbound-parser.zip --region eu-west-1
